dedupe_keys.name: norfolk southern railroad emergency response planning guide 2025

description: The Railroad Emergency Response Planning Guide is a 60-page reference that Norfolk Southern Railway, a major freight railroad in the eastern United States, publishes for local emergency response organisations planning for incidents on its network; the 2025 edition is part of its Operation Awareness and Response programme launched in 2015. It is organised in sections on prevention, preparedness, recognition and identification, and response, with appendices. Contents include contact numbers and notification procedures for hazardous materials incidents, how to identify the owner of a local rail line, information on monitoring and air dispersion modelling, bridge and tunnel incident considerations, shipping document descriptions and examples, rail car placarding, and resources such as the AskRail mobile app for looking up shipment contents, TRANSCAER outreach, a safety training train and training at the Security and Emergency Response Training Center in Pueblo. Coverage: the Norfolk Southern network in the eastern United States. Access: free PDF. Licence and cost: free to read, company copyright. Caveats: written by the railroad for its own lines, with no incident data; procedures may change between editions. It supports emergency response planning and hazmat scenario definition for rail corridors, for example after derailments. It relates to the rail network layers of the National Transportation Atlas Database in the catalogue.
